name: EasyOptOuts
priceNote: 150-day money-back guarantee. No family plan ('we don't offer a family plan'); business is $19.99/employee/year. The cheapest removal service in this comparison.
brokerCountLabel: "200+" high-visibility data brokers and people-search sites — its official sites page names 215 supported domains
rescanLabel: "Three scans per year" — a scan every 4 months

features.label: Broker scan
features.norton: Yes — scans supported people-search & data broker sites and shows which have your data

features.label: Automated removal included
features.norton: No — included Privacy Monitor is manual opt-out. Automated removal only with Privacy Monitor Assistant add-on, $109.99/yr or $12.99/mo
features.rival: Yes — '100% automated opt-out requests (no foreign contractors accessing your data)'

features.label: Broker count stated
features.norton: Page by page on norton.com — the Privacy Monitor Assistant product page (us.norton.com/products/privacy-monitor-assistant) says 'over 2,000' data broker sites; the Privacy Monitor feature page (us.norton.com/feature/privacy-monitor) says 'over 200'; the support list names sites individually with no total. Used in this comparison: 'over 2,000' from the Assistant product page on the main site — the Assistant is the removal product. No staging page is used as a source anywhere in this comparison
features.rival: "200+" — and its sites page names 215 supported domains (direct + state-privacy-law + indirectly-supported)

features.label: Rescan speed
features.norton: Every 90 days (Privacy Monitor Assistant); Privacy Monitor scan re-run every 3 months
features.rival: Every 4 months — 'Three scans per year to maintain opt-outs and cover new sites'

features.label: Custom removal requests
features.norton: Offered via Reputation Defender executive/corporate products only (quote-led, 'when possible', no published price, no consumer product): ExecutivePrivacy — “Custom removal requests, when possible”; Total Radius — “Custom Data Removals”; VIP Services — “Deep Web privacy protection, including custom removal requests”. No Norton consumer product offers custom removals — Privacy Monitor Assistant covers its supported broker list only
features.rival: No — 'We only list sites that we cover as part of our regular, automated scans for every customer'

features.label: Google results removal
features.norton: Yes — via Reputation Defender (separate purchase, reputationdefender.com): “Push negative content or misleading search results down to pages where virtually nobody will ever see them”; its FAQ: “in certain cases online content in your search results can be permanently deleted”. Reputation Defender suppresses negative content in search results and deletes content where possible — it does not make de-indexing requests to Google
features.rival: Yes — homepage: “Remove your personal information from Google searches and data brokers” (easyoptouts.com/) — broker-source removal; its site notes search engines like Google and Bing 'take a few weeks to update their search results' after removal. Applied as stated 12 Nov 2026 (a judgement call on the homepage quote — the daily re-check confirms)

features.label: Removal proof
features.norton: Results list + opt-out tracking; email once a batch of opt-outs has been sent. Screenshots: Not stated on official site
features.rival: An email summarizing findings after each round of scans and opt-outs. Dashboard / screenshots: Not stated on official site

features.label: Tracker & cookie blocking
features.norton: Yes — Tracker & Cookie Blocking (support). Full ad blocking: Not stated on official site ('limit targeted ads')

features.label: Fingerprint protection
features.norton: "Disguise your digital fingerprint automatically each time you browse" — support: anti-fingerprinting will 'return dummy data' to websites

features.label: Email aliases + tracker blocking
features.norton: Yes — create unlimited email aliases (AntiTrack Private Email) and block hidden email trackers

features.label: App / OS-level protection
features.norton: Yes — Windows OS Tracker Blocking: blocks tracking activities and targeted ads by the Windows operating system (support)

features.label: Tracking dashboard
features.norton: Yes — Tracking Dashboard shows real-time blocked trackers, ranked by level of concern / risk

tiers.highlight: 100% automated opt-outs from 200+ sites (214 named) · three scans a year, every 4 months
tiers.name: EasyOptOuts Personal (only plan)
tiers.note: One plan only — no family plan. Business is the same $19.99 per employee/year. Custom removals explicitly not offered.

refs.label: EasyOptOuts pricing
refs.proves: $19.99/year Personal Plan, 200+, three scans per year, the no-custom-removals FAQ

refs.label: EasyOptOuts: sites covered (named list)
refs.proves: 215 named supported domains in three groups — and the 'Sites we don't support' section naming PeopleConnect sites it cannot remove
